assessment_scope: Formal Proposal Review of repository-wide current-design cleanup after owner-authorized vision clarification. Assesses challenge, goals, scope, principle, direction, feasibility, impact, vision fit, downstream authority and requested decision. Recording mode formal-lifecycle; automation mode manual; assembly PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
independence_basis: Separate delegated reviewer agent /root/proposal_reviewer did not author or edit the proposal, VISION, positioning rationale or governance changes. Parent codex-author authored the reviewed contribution; reviewer independently inspected final subjects and recorded this first-pass assessment.
limitations: Direction-level assessment only; no exhaustive retirement dependency graph, file-level deletion approval, proof adequacy, implementation or final Verify judgment is claimed.

Parent reported focused prose, README-marker, readability and diff checks; this assessment independently inspected content and consumer evidence rather than treating those checks as semantic approval.
Manual formal review records its assessment and returns control to the parent; no automatic downstream stage or activity transition is performed.
rationale: Challenge, goals, governing principle and direction: pass. The proposal identifies competing historical/current sources and dependent checks, requires real removals with preserved current meaning, and avoids a new archival or validation platform.

Scope and scope preservation: pass. The original document families and unnecessary check scripts remain visible; current consumer reconciliation is an explicit same-slice dependency and completed historical evidence a separate implementation slice. Every selected family needs disposition, with justified current retention; no hidden follow-up or deletion quota narrows the request.

Feasibility: pass. Exactly one embedded assessment distinguishes known consumer evidence from unresolved per-file safety. Tracked-file counts independently match 5 archive, 54 ADR/architecture, 107 report, 102 top-level test-spec and 3 reference files. Inspected boundary_first_reference.py and release_execution.py confirm active reference/report consumers. The project map contains obsolete v2 wording, so direct sources provide the bounded implementation basis.

Material impact and vision alignment: pass; vision outcome aligned. Current VISION and positioning distinguish reconstructable current reliance from recoverable retired history. The user requested this clarification before proceeding. Git-only historical retention and shallow-checkout limitations are disclosed without imposing Git on customer projects or discarding current review/release evidence.

Downstream authority and requested decision: pass. Design owns exact transfers, compatibility and removal exceptions; Delivery owns sequencing and proof allocation. Independent final review and Verify remain required. The existing parallel-test initiative retains its direction and actual adoption state. Proposal approval does not approve deletion, implementation, adoption or external action.

Specialized gates: scope_budget_context true and satisfied by explicit treatments and boundaries; vision_exception_context false because the owner-authorized current VISION is aligned; standing_artifact_context false because Constitution and VISION are present. No trigger ambiguity, material findings, blockers or required proposal edits.
summary: The cleanup direction is valuable, bounded and feasible enough for detailed Design; current reliance remains self-contained while retired history may use Git.
